messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 30(5)

Article 30 Requirements relating to notified bodies. 5. A conformity assessment body and its personnel shall carry out the conformity assessment activities with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite technical competence in the specific field and shall be free from all pressures and inducements, particularly financial, which might influence its judgement or the results of its conformity assessment activities, especially as regards persons or groups of persons with an interest in the results of those activities.

response.text:
conformity assessment body and its personnel | shall carry out conformity assessment activities | with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite technical competence in the specific field | | "shall carry out the conformity assessment activities with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite technical competence in the specific field"
conformity assessment body and its personnel | shall be free from | all pressures and inducements, particularly financial, that might influence its judgement or the results of its conformity assessment activities | | "shall be free from all pressures and inducements, particularly financial, which might influence its judgement or the results of its conformity assessment activities"
conformity assessment body and its personnel | shall be free from pressures and inducements | from persons or groups of persons with an interest in the results | especially as regards such persons or groups | "especially as regards persons or groups of persons with an interest in the results of those activities"
